title: Giving praised, asking disparaged
odia:
ଦେବା ଠାରୁ ପୁଣ୍ୟ ନାହିଁ
ମାଗିବା ଠାରୁ ହୀନ ନାହିଁ।
literal_meaning: Nothing is more meritorious than giving; nothing is lower than asking.
meaning_odia: ଦେବାକୁ ସବୁଠୁ ପୁଣ୍ୟର କାମ ଓ ମାଗିବାକୁ ସବୁଠୁ ହୀନ କାମ ବୋଲି ଏହି ଢଗ କହେ। ଏହା ଦାନକୁ ପ୍ରଶଂସା କରିବା ସହ ସହାୟତା ମାଗିବାକୁ ଛୋଟ କରୁଥିବା ଏକ ମୂଲ୍ୟବୋଧକୁ ଦେଖାଏ। ଏହି ମୂଲ୍ୟବିଚାର ମୂଳ କଥାର; ସହାୟତା ଦରକାର ହେବାରୁ କାହାର ମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦା କମେ ନାହିଁ।
explanation: The parallel lines put giving at the top of a moral scale and asking at the bottom. The praise of generosity therefore comes with a harsh judgement of dependence. Read critically, the saying reveals that hierarchy; it does not establish why anyone asks for help or diminish their dignity.
usage_example: Original imagined example: In a discussion about charity, someone quotes the saying to praise giving. Another participant points out that generosity can be valued without shaming the person who needs it.
cultural_context: The word ପୁଣ୍ୟ gives the first line a moral and religious register, while ହୀନ supplies the opposing judgement in the second. Repeating ଠାରୁ and ନାହିଁ makes both claims absolute.

witnesses.locator: Page25, eighth item beginning ଦେବା ଠାରୁ ପୁଣ୍ୟ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact two-line text retained. Comparative syntax translated as nothing more meritorious/nothing lower. Critical response to the stigma of asking is editorial.
